body:
Real Content-Type bug found via a live Playwright run against production right after the founder deployed the nginx proxy: MediaRecorder's real mimeType includes codec params (audio/webm;codecs=opus), which never matched the server's bare-type allowlist -- every real recording was rejected. Fixed with mime.ParseMediaType for the allowlist/extension check while still storing the original header for accurate later playback. New regression test with the exact real Content-Type. Rebuilt + restarted iduna.service, re-ran the same Playwright script end to end against production: record -> sign in via popup -> save -> appears in my mixes with a working download. IDUNA@acba484.

⚓ ☃
title: MIXFORGE recordings: fixed Content-Type mismatch, verified live end-to-end (S513)
